source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeInvocableProcessNestedDtoEvidenceTest { @isTest static void invocableRows() { Invocable.Action.AdditionalAttribute attr = new Invocable.Action.AdditionalAttribute(); System.assertEquals(null, attr.getApexClass()); System.assertEquals(null, attr.getDataType()); System.assertEquals(false, attr.getIsCollection()); System.assertEquals(null, attr.getName()); System.assertEquals(null, attr.getValue()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsBooleanList().size()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsDateList().size()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsDoubleList().size()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsIntegerList().size()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsList().size()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsLongList().size()); System.assertEquals(0, attr.getValueAsStringList().size()); Invocable.Action.Error err = new Invocable.Action.Error(); System.assertEquals(null, err.getCode()); System.assertEquals(null, err.getMessage()); Invocable.Action.Error copied = (Invocable.Action.Error) err.clone(); System.assertNotEquals(null, copied); System.assertEquals(null, copied.getCode()); Invocable.Action.GenericType genericType = new Invocable.Action.GenericType(); System.assertEquals(null, genericType.getDescription()); System.assertEquals(null, genericType.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(null, genericType.getName()); System.assertEquals(null, genericType.getSuperType()); Invocable.Action.OutputParameter output = new Invocable.Action.OutputParameter(); System.assertEquals(0, output.getAdditionalAttributes().size()); System.assertEquals(null, output.getApexClass()); System.assertEquals(null, output.getDescription()); System.assertEquals(null, output.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(0, output.getMaxOccurs()); System.assertEquals(null, output.getName()); System.assertEquals(0, output.getPicklistValues().size()); System.assertEquals(null, output.getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals(null, output.getType()); Invocable.Action.PicklistValue pick = new Invocable.Action.PicklistValue(); System.assertEquals(false, pick.getActive()); System.assertEquals(false, pick.getDefaultValue()); System.assertEquals(null, pick.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(null, pick.getValidFor()); System.assertEquals(null, pick.getValue()); } }
